Base Appearance

General

New
Run, before the peach blossoms scatter...!
Cookie Info & Loading
The best way to master poison is to test it on yourself. Ahaha! To fall out of their favor... just the thought makes my dough crawl...!
Justice, honor, friendship... I've never lost to fools who believe in that. Your dough's changing color like petals withering away... How beautiful!
Failure? Please. That's for the talentless. When you stand before true power... there's nothing left but to kneel.
Ugh... how irritating... utterly insufferable! Oh? Oops! Did I just throw a dagger without warning?
You came at me with that level of skill? How insulting. Aw, seeing you writhe in pain breaks my heart. Let me put you out of your misery.
Tired
Tch... was my poison too weak...?!

Lobby

Daily Reward
Payment for amusing me! Come challenge me again sometime.
Tap
Ever heard of the Cult's fang of poison? This elixir makes poison bloom in your dough like petals. Care for a taste?
Oh dear, how pitiful. But tell me... why come to me for an antidote? So you get to keep your life? Clever little thing!
*Yawn...* Too slow... I nearly fell asleep. Pathetic! Over already? And here I thought you'd make this more... entertaining.
The freedom I felt leaving the fire behind... beyond words. My daggers don't always fly straight. Best watch your back!
Those who've only basked in sulight will never know the depth of the shadows. I must be recognized... This time, I have to catch their eye... If not, I'm nothing.
Conditional
(These quotes require certain conditions to be met in order to trigger it in your Lobby)
When placed in the Sanctum of the Ruthless Lobby Here, it's not about survival... It's about being the one who's less forgotten...
When placed in a Lobby with Obscure Umbra Cookie,  Advent of Evil Incarnate or  All Roses Have Thorns The fact that I'm still breathing must mean I was useful today, don't you think, Master?
When placed in a Lobby with Peach Cookie,  Beach Party,  Garden of Delights, or  Nimble Delivery Dasher Slowly... I'll win. Then make you kneel... or beg through tears. What a sight that'll be.
Gift
Neutral This is so useless. I suppose you don't value your life, huh?
Given Flask of Silent Venom Your life hanging on a single vial... how does it feel? Can you sense the poison spreading?
Given Royal Golden Dough Resources are always welcome... perhaps the Master will be pleased?

General

Cookie Info & Loading
A sweet offering... for the Master! Why challenge me... when you could just drink the poison yourself?
Watch every breath. Even the air is mine to weaponize! An antidote? Oh, I have one. But I've no intention of giving it to you.
Pain is honest... It strips you down to your most honest self. The best way to test poison is to test it on yourself. Ahaha!
Is this really an antidote? Tell me... Can you trust me? Aw, seeing you writhe in pain breaks my heart. Let me put you out of your misery.*
Your dough's changing color like petals withering away... How beautiful!* Oh? Oops! Did I just throw a dagger without warning?*
Tired
Ugh... how did you... neutralize the poison...?

Lobby

Daily Reward
Payment for amusing me! Come challenge me again sometime.
Tap
Here to put me down? Haha... how amusing! Why so weary? I haven't even started.
Sparring with you only dulls my edge. Not even good for amusement. To think you're an apprentice... Your master must be ashamed.
Reaching the Cult's second seat... you think that was easy? You're asking me for an antidote? Ha, then you should beg for it!
Out of breath... Dough hardening... Guess we'll talk again... in your next life! This is the Way of the Cult! Clever, ruthless, and absolute!
Better to break than disappoint them! I'll brew a poison deadlier than ever! I'll bloom the most beautiful, the most lethal poison flower for them!

General

Cookie Info & Loading
Stop right there! If you're following the rules, you should'nt(sic) be scared. Aw, seeing you fear for your permanent record breaks my heart.
Climbing over the walls, hm? Did you even read our student handbook? I look like a delinquent? Looks can be deceiving! But you're not wrong, hah!
Look who's naughty! Tell me your name and homeroom class! Don't even think about running... Everything in the school gates is mine!
I'll drill the rules into you... In a way you're sure to remember. Why so weary? I haven't even started.*

Everyone says I'm scary as the student council president! I'm nice... if you follow the rules. Not just any Cookie can become the student council president!
You want me to let you off easy? Aww, I could... But I've no intention of doing it. Speaking from experience, you don't wanna know what happens if you get too many marks on your record...
Where's your name tay? Hmm. I doubt you'd do something so dumb as to forget it! Oopsie, you got caught! Punishments are worse for repeat offenders, you know.
You dare stand aginst(sic) the student council? How cute... I'll teach you how things work around here. School uniforms MUST be worn at all times! You didn't know? I'll make sure you never forget it.
Hesitating when you see me just makes you seem that much more suspicious! I'd never want to disappoint our principal... I'm going to look over our rule book again!
